# Plant: Process analyses with Git

version: 0.4.1 – 2026-10-21

This plant concretizes section 5 of the employee agreement. It regulates investigations to improve workflows. A new regular analysis begins only after documented question, information and necessary approval.

- Responsible: overall coordination Eva Brandt
- Technical implementation: Samir Demir and designated representation
- Technical examination: responsible editorial department
- Objections and data protection: Data Protection Office of the Academies Association / Staff Representation
- Review: half-yearly and before any extension of purpose or method

## Question and scope

An analysis describes work steps and error classes. Raw data is only read to the required extent. Reports do not contain personal rankings. The reconstruction of individual changes is not issued as complete proof of cause or responsibility.

## 2. Access, disclosure and deadlines

Samir and his representative work on the released investigation data in the protected working environment. Nora checks the professional classification. Eva and the relevant editorial staff receive the limited report on process findings. Publishers and expert experts do not receive any personal raw data.

Exports of analysis are deleted 90 days after completion. The expertly reviewed process report is held for two years and then examined on further demand. Scientific source histories are subject to the separate archive concept.

## 3. Excluded uses

Individual working hours, performance rankings and automatic personnel decisions are not derived. Time stamps may reconstruct the order in the search for errors released here; a new evaluation of day times or individual work patterns is thus not allowed. Pseudomym data are not treated as anonymous.

## 4. Modification, objections and old data

New methods, recipients or purposes will be discussed in advance with the team and examined institutionally. Older data will only be included after separate examination of purpose, necessity and information obligations. This annex does not give retroactive consent. Controversial new evaluations will be suspended until clarification.

## Analysis sheet BUG-58: The incorrect return import

- Question: Does the comment surface change checked characters and time periods?
- Data: the affected comments and appropriate counter-examples of the current volume; versions before and after reimport, schema/register rule and check deduction.
- Method: git blame/show and version comparisons; comparison by processing route and error class. Daytimes and individual work patterns are not evaluated.
- Implementation: Samir and technical representation; technical acceptance: Nora. Eva and the affected editors receive the process report.
- Environment: institutional GitLab and local XML evaluation; no upload to external analysis or AI services. Export cancellation 90 days after completion, review after two years.
- Measures: Apply transition test H06 immediately, revise the comment tool in parallel and decrease the return journey with regression test; then recheck the manual. Previous night observation does not become a routine and is not part of this analysis task.
